title: EventBatch
description: Daemon-only canonical persisted event batch for v0. This contract is not an external write request and is never accepted from clients. A batch must have at least one event, contiguous zero-based ordinals, and canonical storage metadata. batch_id is a UUIDv7 immutable identifier that must be unique across all accepted persisted batches; it must never be reused for a different command. The persisted command idempotency metadata is internal to the daemon and is not the HTTP Idempotency-Key request field.

batch_id.description: Globally unique, immutable UUIDv7 identifier for this accepted batch.

committed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for the persisted batch.

command.description: Daemon-only canonical command metadata. The persisted idempotency_key is storage metadata and is not accepted in the external command request, which carries Idempotency-Key as an HTTP header.

arguments.description: JSON command arguments. Its canonical serialized form is part of the command payload digest input.

idempotency_key.description: Daemon-only persisted idempotency metadata; clients must not submit this field.

events.description: Events are persisted in ordinal order. Ordinals must be exactly 0 through N-1.

referenced_blobs.description: Authoritative manifest of every BlobRef used by typed event payloads. Every payload BlobRef must be declared here, and every entry is validated before append. Contract validation does not infer references by recursively scanning arbitrary JSON.
